Home Mortgage Disclosure Act - HMDA. DEFINITION of 'Home Mortgage Disclosure Act - HMDA'. A federal act approved in 1975 that requires mortgage lenders to keep records of certain key pieces of information regarding their lending practices. This information includes the number of pre-approvals made, the number of mortgages granted, loan amounts, etc.
